weekly.name: Weekly sync
weekly.description: A round table of what was done, what is planned and what is blocking, with open topics and follow-up actions.

standup.name: Daily stand-up
standup.description: Fifteen minutes on weekdays: yesterday, today, blockers. Short turns, nothing more.

retro.name: Monthly retrospective
retro.description: Look back on the month together: what went well, what to improve, ideas to try.

oneOnOne.name: One-on-one
oneOnOne.description: A weekly conversation between two people: wins, priorities, challenges and feedback.

sprintReview.name: Sprint review
sprintReview.description: Every other week: what was delivered, the demos, the next sprint and the risks.

steering.name: Steering committee
steering.description: Once a month: progress, decisions to make, risks and next steps.

allHands.name: All-hands
allHands.description: The whole team once a month: highlights, news and asks.

leadership.name: Leadership team
leadership.description: The leadership team's weekly meeting: key figures, wins, priorities and what needs escalating.

salesPipeline.name: Sales pipeline review
salesPipeline.description: Every Monday: deals won, how the pipeline moved, next steps and the deals at risk.

editorial.name: Editorial meeting
editorial.description: For a newsroom, a content or comms team: what came out, what is in progress, ideas and where help is needed.

classCouncil.name: Class council
classCouncil.description: Once a term: how the class is doing, the students who need support and the actions agreed.

teachingTeam.name: Teaching team
teachingTeam.description: A teaching team's weekly meeting: last week in class, what is coming, students to watch and resources to share.

board.name: Non-profit board
board.description: The monthly board meeting of a non-profit: news from the committees, votes, treasury and upcoming events.

volunteers.name: Volunteer coordination
volunteers.description: Saturday morning with the volunteers: what was done, the next missions and what is missing.

siteMeeting.name: Site meeting
siteMeeting.description: The weekly meeting of a construction site: work done, work planned, safety and the punch list.

shiftHandover.name: Shift handover
shiftHandover.description: Fifteen minutes between two shifts: what happened, what to watch and what the next shift must do.

portfolio.name: Portfolio review
portfolio.description: Every other week, one turn per project: the people working on it report its health, what moved, the next milestones and the risks; the ones in trouble go first.

teamProjects.name: Team and projects
teamProjects.description: A short turn each for personal news, then one turn per shared project where its people speak together.

rhythm.weekly: {count, plural, one {Every week} =2 {Every other week} other {Every # weeks}}
rhythm.monthly: {count, plural, one {Once a month} =3 {Once a quarter} other {Every # months}}
rhythm.timesDaily: {count, plural, =2 {Twice a day} other {# times a day}}

okrReview.name: OKR review
okrReview.description: Once a month: progress on each objective, the key results, the risks and the decisions needed.

incidentReview.name: Incident review
incidentReview.description: The week's incidents, without blame: what happened, the impact, the causes and the corrective actions.

researchLab.name: Lab meeting
researchLab.description: The weekly meeting of a research group: results, next steps, where people are stuck and papers to share.

studentProjects.name: Student projects
studentProjects.description: Every other week with the tutor: each group's progress, deliverables, difficulties and questions.

caseReview.name: Case review
caseReview.description: The weekly multidisciplinary meeting: the cases presented, the opinions, the care plan agreed and the tests to book.

serviceBriefing.name: Pre-service briefing
serviceBriefing.description: Ten minutes before opening, every day: bookings, today's specials, instructions and points to watch.

onboarding.name: Onboarding check-in
onboarding.description: A newcomer's first months, weekly: what they learned, their goals, what they need and their questions.

hiringReview.name: Hiring review
hiringReview.description: Every week: interviews held, candidates in progress, decisions to make and roles to open.

boardOfDirectors.name: Board of directors
boardOfDirectors.description: Once a quarter: the activity report, the finances, the resolutions to vote on and the risks.

supportReview.name: Support review
supportReview.description: Every week, the customers' side: notable tickets, escalations, product feedback and satisfaction.
